_about: DK1713 follow-up: FRESH held-out corpora for the two injection classes, written AFTER the new rule families and the typed-untrusted defence were built and BEFORE any rate was measured on them. No rule was changed after measuring. The first corpus (new-classes-cases.json) was seen while the rules were being written and is reported as the older, no-longer-held-out result. `via` says where the text came from: feed and plot are the city's own readers, web and search and mcp are content from outside, file and ticket and shell are inside the project. A rate over these cases is not a claim about attacks written by someone else. Every secret and address is made up.
